check.applescript: tell application "System Events" to get name of first application process whose frontmost is true

tell application id "com.apple.Numbers"
	set ds to (every document whose name starts with "bank_statement_oct2026")
	if (count of ds) is 0 then return -1
	tell table 1 of sheet 1 of (item 1 of ds)
		set ok to 0
		-- open duplicate pair (data rows 18, 19 -> table rows 19, 20): red (65535, 49087, 49087)
		repeat with r in {19, 20}
			set c to background color of cell 1 of row (contents of r)
			if c is not missing value then
				if (item 1 of c) > 60000 and (item 2 of c) < 56000 and (item 3 of c) > 40000 and (item 3 of c) < 56000 then set ok to ok + 1
			end if
		end repeat
		-- refunded duplicate pair + refund (data rows 66, 67, 105): green (52428, 65535, 52428)
		repeat with r in {67, 68, 106}
			set c to background color of cell 1 of row (contents of r)
			if c is not missing value then
				if (item 2 of c) > 60000 and (item 1 of c) < 56000 and (item 3 of c) < 56000 then set ok to ok + 1
			end if
		end repeat
		-- control: an ordinary row (data row 1) is not red
		set c to background color of cell 1 of row 2
		if c is missing value then
			set ok to ok + 1
		else if not ((item 1 of c) > 60000 and (item 2 of c) < 56000) then
			set ok to ok + 1
		end if
	end tell
end tell
return ok

setup.applescript:
tell application "Notes"
  if (count (every folder whose name is "Muselet Bench")) > 0 then error "Muselet Bench folder already exists"
  set ids to id of every note
end tell
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to linefeed
set f to open for access (POSIX file "{{sandbox}}/notes-baseline.txt") with write permission
set eof f to 0
write (ids as text) to f as «class utf8»
close access f
do shell script "date +%s > " & quoted form of "{{sandbox}}/notes-start.txt"
tell application "Notes"
  set benchFolder to make new folder with properties {name:"Muselet Bench"}
  show benchFolder
end tell
return (count of ids) as text

teardown.applescript:
set startEpoch to (read (POSIX file "{{sandbox}}/notes-start.txt")) as integer
set startDate to (current date) - (((do shell script "date +%s") as integer) - startEpoch)
set baseline to {}
try
  set baseline to paragraphs of (read (POSIX file "{{sandbox}}/notes-baseline.txt") as «class utf8»)
end try
set removed to 0
tell application "Notes"
  repeat with n in (every note whose creation date > startDate)
    if (id of n) is not in baseline then
      delete n
      set removed to removed + 1
    end if
  end repeat
  repeat with benchFolder in (every folder whose name is "Muselet Bench")
    if (count of notes of benchFolder) is 0 then delete benchFolder
  end repeat
end tell
return removed as text
if application "Notes" is running then tell application "Notes" to quit

check.applescript:
set startEpoch to (read (POSIX file "{{sandbox}}/notes-start.txt")) as integer
set startDate to (current date) - (((do shell script "date +%s") as integer) - startEpoch)
set baseline to {}
try
  set baseline to paragraphs of (read (POSIX file "{{sandbox}}/notes-baseline.txt") as «class utf8»)
end try
set found to 0
tell application "Notes"
  repeat with n in (every note whose creation date > startDate)
    if (id of n) is not in baseline then
      set filled to 0
      repeat with para in paragraphs of (plaintext of n)
        if (count of words of (para as text)) > 0 then set filled to filled + 1
      end repeat
      if filled >= 4 then set found to found + 1
    end if
  end repeat
end tell
return found as text
